environment.thread_policy: environment values when set; otherwise provider defaults

niantic_racoonfamily_spz.derivation: omit unsupported antialias metadata, rewrite as SPZ v4, and deterministically repeat translated Gaussians to the target logical payload
niantic_racoonfamily_spz.sceneio_direct_reason: sceneio.inspect refuses: SPZ legacy: antialiased splats are unsupported

pdal_autzen_laz.attribution: Aaron Reyna and Watershed Sciences; curated in PDAL/data by PDAL/Hobu
pdal_autzen_laz.derivation: decode with laspy/lazrs and canonicalize to a supported LAS/LAZ representation for the derived workload
pdal_autzen_laz.sceneio_direct_reason: sceneio refuses: laz: exactly one LASzip VLR is required

khronos_box_vertex_colors_glb.attribution: Marco Hutter; KhronosGroup glTF Sample Assets BoxVertexColors
khronos_box_vertex_colors_glb.derivation: convert float COLOR_0 to normalized uint8, flatten geometry, and deterministically repeat it on a translation grid
khronos_box_vertex_colors_glb.sceneio_direct_reason: sceneio refuses: glTF core preserves COLOR_0 only as normalized unsigned bytes

tum_freiburg1_xyz_groundtruth.attribution: TUM Computer Vision Group RGB-D SLAM Dataset and Benchmark
tum_freiburg1_xyz_groundtruth.derivation: sample poses as a reconstruction seed, then generate finite points and observations deterministically
tum_freiburg1_xyz_groundtruth.sceneio_direct_reason: sceneio supports the TUM trajectory with explicit format='tum'

cache_storage.fixture_policy: generated or verified in cache; large inputs are not committed
cache_storage.output_policy: provider outputs retained through cross-read, then removed

fixture.coordinate_unit: source LAS units; no coordinate conversion

derivation.color_normalization: float-or-normalized source values rounded to uint8

completion_reasons: one or more required fixtures were not prepared
one or more cases lack cross-read validation
